verdict.rationale: Adyen's Management API lets developers order terminals and accessories by API instead of through the Customer Area, under a documented 'automating terminal management' section. That is first-party, API-based fleet provisioning, but it covers only the ordering step of the fleet lifecycle. The other terminal-management evidence refers to the Customer Area UI, not an API. Missing for 10: API-based device registration or assignment, remote status and health monitoring of terminals, remote configuration updates via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
